name: uengage.io/i18n
description: Per-business i18n helpers for uEngage (currency formatting today). Resolves a business's currency/country from the platform Business API and formats with the right symbol and separators. PHP port of @uengage.io/i18n.

suggest.ext-intl: Formats with ICU (NumberFormatter). Without it a built-in table for the Meridian markets (IN, CA, AE, NZ, PT, US) is used.
suggest.uengage.io/php-platform-sdk: Needed by forBusinessId() to read the business locale from the platform Business API.
